transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I, uh… I’m here because I’ve been having thoughts that maybe my family would be better off if I didn’t wake up. It scared me enough that I told my supervisor.
Have you had any specific plans or intentions about how you would end your life?
I… I don’t really have a plan like that. It’s more these thoughts that my family might be better off if I just didn’t wake up. That’s what scared me enough to tell my supervisor.
Have you had these kinds of thoughts before, or has this only started recently?
It’s… mostly recently that it got bad enough to scare me. I keep thinking my family might be better off if I didn’t wake up, and that’s why I told my supervisor.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to mess with my tomato plants, sand wood out at my bench, watch the Falcons… hang around after church talking. Lately I just kind of look at all that like it belongs to somebody else.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don’t know… I guess I’ve been pretty low a lot of the time. Most days, yeah, it’s there.
Have you been feeling like you’re a burden to others or that you’re not worth much lately?
Yeah… some. I keep thinking about my daughter leaving, and I tell myself I must’ve failed her somehow. Like… if I’d been a better father, maybe I would’ve done something different.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
Yeah… I haven’t been eating much. Most days I kind of have to make myself take a few bites. Stuff I’d usually eat at work or at home just… sits there, and I end up throwing it out.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, have you been more restless or unable to sit still lately?
Yeah… slower, I guess. People at work have been asking if I’m sick. I walk slower, and sometimes it takes me a while to answer even simple stuff. Feels like I’m moving through mud.
Before this recent period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been coming and going for maybe a year now. This time, after my daughter left… it’s been the worst.
Before this most recent episode, did you have any other periods in the past that were similar—where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least a couple of weeks at a time?

Yeah… there were other stretches. Over the past year or so, it’s kind of come and gone. I’d feel low for a while, lose interest in things… a couple weeks or more, I guess. This time after my daughter left has been the hardest.
